auctionTerms.title: Auction Seller Terms
auctionTerms.intro: Before listing an auction, please read and agree to the following seller responsibilities:
auctionTerms.authenticityContent: Sellers must ensure listed items are legally owned. Descriptions, condition grades, and images must accurately reflect the item. False descriptions or misrepresentation will result in immediate removal and account ban.
auctionTerms.shippingContent: After auction ends and buyer pays, seller must ship within 3 business days and enter a valid tracking number. Late shipment will be recorded as a violation, affecting account rating and listing privileges.
auctionTerms.withdrawContent: Once an auction has received bids, sellers may not withdraw without cause. Contact customer service if withdrawal is necessary. Malicious withdrawal is treated as a violation: first offense is a warning, repeat offenses will restrict listing privileges.
auctionTerms.feeContent: A 5% service fee is charged on each successful auction, deducted automatically after buyer payment. Seller payout is the final price minus the service fee.
auctionTerms.newSellerContent: New sellers with fewer than 5 completed transactions have a starting bid cap of HK$5,000. Auctions with starting bids over HK$10,000 are subject to high-value risk monitoring.
auctionTerms.violationContent: Violations (false descriptions, malicious withdrawal, late shipment, etc.) are handled as follows: 1st offense: Warning → 2nd: 7-day listing restriction → 3rd: 30-day ban → 4th: Permanent ban.
auctionTerms.protectionContent: The platform has a mutual rating system. After auction completion, buyers can rate sellers (publicly displayed on seller profile). Sellers can also rate buyers to maintain a healthy trading environment.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What cards can be submitted for PSA grading?
faq.a1: PSA accepts all types of trading card games, including Pokémon TCG, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic: The Gathering, One Piece TCG, etc.
faq.q2: How do I choose a service tier?
faq.a2: Consider two factors: (1) Card market value — choose a tier with a max declared value higher than your card's market value; (2) Time needed — choose Express for faster grading.
faq.q3: How do I track progress after shipping?
faq.a3: Every status update will be notified via in-app messages and email. You can also log in to check the real-time status on the application detail page.
faq.a4: Payment is in two stages: (1) Full service fee paid when submitting; (2) After grading, if you paid in full at step 1, no additional payment is needed.
faq.q5: When would I need to pay a price difference?
faq.a5: Only when grading reveals the need to upgrade the service tier. If you chose the appropriate tier at submission, you typically won't need to pay any difference.
faq.q6: What if the grade is lower than expected?
faq.a6: PSA grading results are final. BOXIUM cannot intervene in grading. If you disagree, you can apply for a review through PSA's official channels (additional fees apply).
faq.q7: What if cards are lost or damaged?
faq.a7: Risk during shipping to BOXIUM is borne by the sender. We recommend using tracked shipping. If damage occurs due to BOXIUM's negligence after receipt, maximum compensation is limited to the service fee.
faq.a8: If payment hasn't been made (awaiting_payment status), you can cancel on the application detail page. Once payment is made and cards are submitted to PSA, cancellation is not possible.

s1.title: 1. Platform Overview
s1.intro: Boxium PTCG ("the Platform") is a Hong Kong trading platform for TCG enthusiasts, offering Buy Now and Auction transaction modes for safe and convenient card trading.
s1.buyNowDesc: Seller sets a fixed price, buyer purchases instantly, transaction confirmed immediately.
s1.auctionDesc: Seller sets a starting price, buyers bid, highest bidder wins when time expires.
s1.infoBox: All transactions on this platform are in Hong Kong Dollars (HKD). Sellers must complete Stripe Connect account setup before listing items.

s2.title: 2. Buy Now Process
s2.b1desc: Browse listings, check item details, condition grade, and seller rating.
s2.b2title: Add to Cart or Buy Now
s2.b2desc: Click "Buy Now" or add to cart and checkout, confirm order details and total.
s2.b3desc: Complete payment via Stripe secure checkout, system confirms order instantly.
s2.b4desc: After seller confirms shipment, complete handover per agreed method.
s2.s1desc: Fill in item name, condition, series, price, and photos, then submit for review.
s2.s2desc: All items require platform admin review before going public to ensure accuracy.
s2.s3desc: Upon receiving order notification, confirm shipment and arrange delivery within the required time.
s2.s4desc: After transaction completes, platform deducts service fee and settles to seller's Stripe account.
s2.warningBox: Once buyer confirms payment, the order is established. Buyer cannot unilaterally cancel except under refund policy conditions.

s3.title: 3. Auction Process & Terms
s3.a1desc: Set starting price, auction duration (3 or 7 days), and optional buy-now price, then submit for review.
s3.a2desc: After login, bid on active auctions; each bid must exceed the current highest bid.
s3.a3desc: When auction time expires, the highest bidder wins automatically. System notifies both parties instantly.
s3.a4desc: Winning buyer must complete payment within 48 hours; failure to do so forfeits the winning bid.
s3.r1desc: Once placed, a bid constitutes a purchase commitment. Payment must be completed after winning, or account will be restricted.
s3.r2desc: If seller sets a buy-now price, buyer can purchase at that price anytime, ending the auction immediately.
s3.r3desc: When outbid, the system automatically notifies the buyer, giving them a chance to bid again.
s3.r4desc: If a new bid is placed within 5 minutes of auction end, the auction extends by 5 minutes to ensure fair bidding.
s3.r5desc: Once an auction has bids, sellers cannot unilaterally cancel; violations will result in platform penalties.
s3.r6desc: After auction ends, system automatically sends payment link to winning buyer; please check notifications.
s3.warningBox: If winning buyer fails to pay within 48 hours, platform may relist the item and take action against the violating account, including restricting bidding privileges.

s4.title: 4. Platform Fee Structure
s4.intro: The platform uses a tiered service fee based on transaction amount—higher amounts have lower rates. Fees are charged to sellers only; buyers pay no additional service fees.
s4.tableTitle: Seller Service Fee Rates (by transaction amount)
s4.example: Sale HKD {{amount}} → Fee HKD {{fee}}, Net HKD {{receive}}
s4.note1: Service fee is automatically deducted at settlement; sellers need not pay separately.
s4.note2: Rate is calculated on individual transaction amount, not cumulative.
s4.note3: Platform reserves the right to adjust rates with 7 days advance notice to sellers.
s4.note4: Stripe payment processing fees are borne by the platform; buyers are not charged extra.
s4.successBox: Listing items and browsing the platform is completely free. Platform only charges service fees upon successful transactions.

s5.title: 5. Payment & Settlement
s5.p1desc: The platform processes all payments via Stripe, supporting Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and other major credit/debit cards.
s5.p2desc: All payments are encrypted via Stripe; the platform does not store any credit card information.
s5.p3desc: Buy-now orders require immediate payment; auction winners must pay within 48 hours.
s5.sp1desc: Sellers must set up and connect a Stripe Connect account to receive payments.
s5.sp2desc: After receiving the item, buyer must click "Confirm Receipt" on the order page. If buyer doesn't confirm within 14 days of shipment, system auto-completes the order.
s5.sp3desc: After buyer confirms receipt (or system auto-completes), funds enter a 48-hour cooling period protection. During this time, buyer can raise a dispute.
s5.sp4desc: After cooling period ends with no disputes, system automatically transfers funds (minus platform service fee) to seller's Stripe Connect account.
s5.sp5desc: If buyer raises a dispute during cooling period, funds are frozen until the dispute is resolved.
s5.infoBox: If seller hasn't set up a Stripe Connect account, funds will be held until account setup is complete. The cooling period protects buyer rights while ensuring sellers receive timely payment when no disputes arise.

s6.title: 6. Shipping Arrangements
s6.intro: The platform uses postal delivery; in-person pickup and store collection are not supported. Buyers choose from the following shipping methods at checkout:

sf.title: SF Express (freight collect)
sf.desc: Seller handles secure packaging and shipping; freight is collected by SF Express and paid by buyer upon pickup. Amount varies by weight and address.

hkpost.title: Hong Kong Post (surface mail)
hkpost.desc: Seller handles secure packaging and shipping; HK$10 shipping fee is automatically added to order total, sent via surface mail.

s6.warningBox: In-person pickup and store collection are not supported. If items are damaged or lost in transit, liability is resolved by mutual agreement; the platform bears no responsibility.

s7.title: 7. Refund & Return Policy
s7.intro: The platform's refund policy prioritizes buyer protection while respecting sellers' reasonable rights.
s7.a1desc: Received item's condition, version, or state significantly differs from seller's description.
s7.a2desc: Item was damaged in transit and not due to buyer's actions.
s7.a3desc: Seller failed to arrange delivery within the promised time without reasonable explanation.
s7.r1desc: Change of mind, duplicate purchase, or personal preference issues are not eligible for refunds.
s7.r2desc: After auction completion, refunds are not accepted except for significant description discrepancies.
s7.r3desc: Items that have been used, modified, or damaged by the buyer are not eligible for refunds.
s7.infoBox: If you need to apply for a refund, please submit a request through platform support within 48 hours of receipt with supporting evidence (e.g., photos). Platform support will assist with your refund.

s8.title: 8. User Code of Conduct
s8.intro: To maintain a fair trading environment, all users must follow these conduct guidelines:
s8.c1desc: Sellers must not describe items with false or misleading information, including condition, version, and authenticity.
s8.c2desc: Using multiple accounts or colluding with others to manipulate auction bids is prohibited.
s8.c3desc: Bypassing the platform for private transactions to avoid service fees is prohibited.
s8.c4desc: Harassing, threatening, or defrauding other users in any form is prohibited.
s8.c5desc: Both buyers and sellers must complete each transaction honestly and in good faith.
s8.c6desc: Both parties should respond to messages and requests within a reasonable time.
s8.p4action: Permanent ban, right to pursue damages reserved
s8.warningBox: Users who violate the code of conduct may face warnings, account suspension, or permanent bans depending on severity. If you believe a violation record is incorrect, you may submit a written appeal to platform support within 7 business days.

s9.title: 9. Disclaimer & Legal Terms
s9.l1desc: The platform serves only as an intermediary for transactions and makes no guarantees about item authenticity, quality, or condition.
s9.l2desc: Both parties assume transaction risks themselves. The platform bears no legal liability for any losses arising from transactions.
s9.l3desc: If the platform is found liable for any matter, maximum liability shall not exceed the service fee actually collected by the platform in the relevant transaction.
s9.l4desc: The platform does not guarantee service continuity or stability; the platform bears no responsibility for interruptions due to technical failures or maintenance.
s9.l5desc: The platform reserves the right to modify terms at any time; modified terms take effect after platform announcement. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
s9.l6desc: These terms are governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; any disputes shall be submitted to Hong Kong courts.
s9.infoBox: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us through the platform support function. We are committed to providing a fair and safe trading environment for all parties.

highlights.h2desc: All bids are legally binding, anti-sniping mechanism ensures fair bidding, and violations are handled appropriately.
